title: RIRS: Routing and Iterative Refining-Solving for Multi-RAG-Agent Question Answering

defines.name: RIRS
defines.definition: A training-free orchestration framework that routes queries to relevant RAG agents using embedding-space knowledge summaries and iteratively refines complex questions across agents.

problem: In multi-RAG-agent settings, relevant evidence is distributed across private agents, making it hard to choose the right agent and to answer complex questions without centralizing knowledge or broadcasting to all agents.
